notes: Qty 58 as published. The strategy opens 'There is supposed to be 4 dreadnuaghts not 1.' – not applied; dested as posted (1 Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser), which with 4 would make 61.

Starting (as posted): Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe (posted 'SYCFA'), Death Star, Death Star docking bay, Alderaan, Prepared Defenses (posted 'Pre Defences'), Mobilization Points, Battle Order and There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement; several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

Battle Order and Secret Plans are the older Effects (Endor; Special Edition), not the Reflections III Defensive Shields. 'Death Star docking bay' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327; 'Aldaran' Alderaan; 'Wakeemui' Wakeelmui; 'Kashyyk' Kashyyyk; 'Commander Marrejk' Commander Merrejk; 'U-3po' U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio).

Bracketed counts read as quantities ('Tie Interceptor[14]' = 14 TIE Interceptor, etc.). 'Dreadnaught Class Cruiser' dested Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Ability Ability Abilty' Ability, Ability, Ability; 'SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannon' SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons.
The description says the deck 'went 5-0 sat.' (no event named), so it is filed as a general deck.
